recite.41: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ وَسَلِّمْ وَبَارِكْ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَآلِهِ
recite.119: أَمْسَيْنَا وَأَمْسَى الْمُلْكُ لِلَّهِ، وَالْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ، لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لاَ شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ، رَبِّ أَسْأَلُكَ خَيْرَ مَا فِي هَذِهِ اللَّيْلَةِ، وَخَيْرَ مَا بَعْدَهَا، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا فِي هَذِهِ اللَّيْلَةِ، وَشَرِّ مَا بَعْدَهَا، رَبِّ أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْكَسَلِ وَسُوءِ الْكِبَرِ، رَبِّ أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ عَذَابٍ فِي النَّارِ وَعَذَابٍ فِي الْقَبْرِ
recite.120: اللَّهُمَّ بِكَ أَمْسَيْنَا، وَبِكَ أَصْبَحْنَا، وَبِكَ نَحْيَا، وَبِكَ نَمُوتُ، وَإِلَيْكَ الْمَصِيرُ
recite.122: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَمْسَيْتُ أُشْهِدُكَ، وَأُشْهِدُ حَمَلَةَ عَرْشِكَ، وَمَلاَئِكَتَكَ، وَجَمِيعَ خَلْقِكَ، أَنَّكَ أَنْتَ اللَّهُ لَا إِلَهَ إِلاَّ أَنْتَ وَحْدَكَ لاَ شَرِيكَ لَكَ، وَأَنَّ مُحَمَّداً عَبْدُكَ وَرَسُولُكَ
recite.123: اللَّهُمَّ مَا أَمْسَى بِي مِنْ نِعْمَةٍ أَوْ بِأَحَدٍ مِنْ خَلْقِكَ فَمِنْكَ وَحْدَكَ لاَ شَرِيكَ لَكَ، فَلَكَ الْحَمْدُ وَلَكَ الشُّكْرُ
recite.131: أَمْسَيْنَا وَأَمْسَى الْمُلْكُ لِلَّهِ رَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ، اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ خَيْرَ هَذِهِ اللَّيْلَةِ: فَتْحَهَا، وَنَصْرَهَا، وَنُورَهَا، وَبَرَكَتَهَا، وَهُدَاهَا، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا فِيهَا، وَشَرِّ مَا بَعْدَهَا
recite.132: أَمْسَيْنَا عَلَى فِطْرَةِ الْإِسْلاَمِ، وَعَلَى كَلِمَةِ الْإِخْلاَصِ، وَعَلَى دِينِ نَبِيِّنَا مُحَمَّدٍ ﷺ، وَعَلَى مِلَّةِ أَبِينَا إِبْرَاهِيمَ، حَنِيفاً مُسْلِماً وَمَا كَانَ مِنَ الْمُشْرِكِينَ
recite.153: أَعُوذُ بِاللَّهِ مِنَ الشَّيْطَانِ وَمِنْ شَرِّ مَا رَأَيْتُ
recite.184: اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ. اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ. اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ. اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ. أَشْهَدُ أَنْ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ. أَشْهَدُ أَنْ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ. أَشْهَدُ أَنَّ مُحَمَّدًا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ. أَشْهَدُ أَنَّ مُحَمَّدًا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ. حَيَّ عَلَى الصَّلَاةِ. حَيَّ عَلَى الصَّلَاةِ. حَيَّ عَلَى الْفَلَاحِ. حَيَّ عَلَى الْفَلَاحِ. اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ. اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ. لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ
recite.242: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ عَذَابِ الْقَبْرِ، وَمِنْ عَذَابِ جَهَنَّمَ، وَمِنْ فِتْنَةِ الْمَحْيَا وَالْمَمَاتِ، وَمِنْ شَرِّ فِتْنَةِ الْمَسِيحِ الدَّجَّالِ، اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْمَأْثَمِ وَالْمَغْرَمِ
recite.89: لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لاَ شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ يُحْيِي وَيُمِيتُ وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ
recite.95: أَصْبَحْنَا وَأَصْبَحَ الْمُلْكُ لِلَّهِ، وَالْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ، لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لاَ شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ، رَبِّ أَسْأَلُكَ خَيْرَ مَا فِي هَذَا الْيَوْمِ وَخَيْرَ مَا بَعْدَهُ، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا فِي هَذَا الْيَوْمِ وَشَرِّ مَا بَعْدَهُ، رَبِّ أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْكَسَلِ وَسُوءِ الْكِبَرِ، رَبِّ أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ عَذَابٍ فِي النَّارِ وَعَذَابٍ فِي الْقَبْرِ
recite.170: اللَّهُمَّ رَبَّ السَّمَوَاتِ السَّبْعِ، وَرَبَّ الْعَرْشِ الْعَظِيمِ، كُنْ لِي جَاراً مِنْ فُلاَنِ بْنِ فُلاَنٍ، وَأَحْزَابِهِ مِنْ خَلاَئِقِكَ، أَنْ يَفْرُطَ عَلَيَّ أَحَدٌ مِنْهُمْ أَوْ يَطْغَى، عَزَّ جَارُكَ، وَجَلَّ ثَنَاؤُكَ، وَلاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ أَنْتَ

fills.text:
[al-Ikhlaas] Say, He is Allah, [who is] One, Allah, the Eternal Refuge. He neither begets nor is born, Nor is there to Him any equivalent.
[al-Falaq] Say, I seek refuge in the Lord of daybreak From the evil of that which He created And from the evil of darkness when it settles And from the evil of the blowers in knots And from the evil of an envier when he envies.
[an-Naas] Say, I seek refuge in the Lord of mankind, The Sovereign of mankind. The God of mankind, From the evil of the retreating whisperer, Who whispers [evil] into the breasts of mankind, From among the jinn and mankind.
fills.note: hisnmuslim.com en item 76 (TRANSLATED_TEXT), verse numbers removed

fills.text: Qul huwal-lahu ahad. Allahus-samad. Lam yalid walam yoolad. Walam yakun lahoo kufuwan ahad. Qul aAAoothu birabbil-falaq. Min sharri ma khalaq. Wamin sharri ghasiqin itha waqab. Wamin sharrin-naffathati fil-AAuqad. Wamin sharri hasidin itha hasad. Qul aAAoothu birabbin-nas. Malikin-nas. Ilahin-nas. Min sharril-waswasil-khannas. Allathee yuwaswisu fee sudoorin-nas. Minal-jinnati wannas.

Allah - there is no deity except Him, the Ever-Living, the Sustainer of [all] existence. Neither drowsiness overtakes Him nor sleep. To Him belongs whatever is in the heavens and whatever is on the earth. Who is it that can intercede with Him except by His permission? He knows what is [presently] before them and what will be after them, and they encompass not a thing of His knowledge except for what He wills. His Kursi extends over the heavens and the earth, and their preservation tires Him not. And He is the Most High, the Most Great.

Allahu la ilaha illa huwal-hayyul-qayyoom, la ta'khuthuhoo sinatun wala nawm, lahoo ma fis-samawati wama fil-ard, man thal-lathee yashfaAAu AAindahoo illa bi-ithnihee, yaAAlamu ma bayna aydeehim wama khalfahum, wala yuheetoona bishay-in min AAilmihee illa bima sha', wasiAAa kursiyyuhus-samawati wal-ard, wala ya-ooduhoo hifthuhuma, wahuwal-AAaliyyul-AAatheem.
Lâ ilâha illâ l-lâhu wahdahu lâ sharîka lahu, lahu l-mulku wa lahu l-hamdu yuhyî wa yumîtu wa huwa calâ kulli shay'in qadîr.
All praise is for Allah alone, and prayers and peace be upon the one after whom there is no prophet.
fills.note: translation of the preface before Ayat al-Kursi

Amsaynâ wa amsâ l-mulku li-l-lâhi, wa-l-hamdu li-l-lâhi, lâ ilâha illâ l-lâhu wahdahu lâ sharîka lahu, lahu l-mulku wa lahu l-hamdu wa huwa calâ kulli shay'in qadîrun, rabbi as'aluka khayra mâ fî hâdhihi l-laylati, wa khayra mâ bacdahâ, wa acûdhu bika min sharri mâ fî hâdhihi l-laylati, wa sharri mâ bacdahâ, rabbi acûdhu bika mina l-kasali wa sû'i l-kibari, rabbi acûdhu bika min cadhâbin fî n-nâri wa cadhâbin fî l-qabr.

O Allah, verily I have reached the evening and call on You, the bearers of Your throne, Your angels, and all of Your creation to witness that You are Allah, none has the right to be worshipped except You, alone, without partner and that Muhammad is Your Servant and Messenger.
fills.note: the published morning meaning (content 98) with "morning" changed to "evening"

fills.text: Allahumma innee amsaytu ushhiduk, wa-ushhidu hamalata AAarshik, wamala-ikatak, wajameeAAa khalqik, annaka antal-lahu la ilaha illa anta wahdaka la shareeka lak, wa-anna Muhammadan AAabduka warasooluk.

Allâhumma innî amsaytu ushhiduka, wa ushhidu hamalata carshika, wa malâ'ikataka, wa jamîca khalqika, annaka anta l-lâhu lâ ilâha illâ anta wahdaka lâ sharîka laka, wa anna Muhammadan cabduka wa rasûluk.
O Allah, whatever blessing I or any of Your creation have this evening is from You alone, without partner, so for You is all praise and unto You all thanks.
fills.note: adapted from the published morning meaning (content 99) for the evening wording

fills.text: Allahumma ma amsa bee min niAAmatin aw bi-ahadin min khalqika faminka wahdaka la shareeka lak, falakal-hamdu walakash-shukr.
Allâhumma mâ amsâ bî min nicmatin aw bi-ahadin min khalqika fa-minka wahdaka lâ sharîka laka, fa-laka l-hamdu wa laka sh-shukr.

Amsaynâ wa amsâ l-mulku li-l-lâhi rabbi l-câlamîna, Allâhumma innî as'aluka khayra hâdhihi l-laylah: fat-hahâ, wa nasrahâ, wa nûrahâ, wa barakatahâ, wa hudâhâ, wa acûdhu bika min sharri mâ fîhâ, wa sharri mâ bacdahâ.

We have reached the evening upon the fitrah of Islam, and the word of pure faith, and upon the religion of our Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him) and the religion of our forefather Ibraheem, who was a Muslim and of true faith and was not of those who associate others with Allah.
fills.note: the published morning meaning (content 108) with "We rise upon" changed to "We have reached the evening upon"

Allahumma salli wasallim AAala nabiyyina Muhammad.

Qul huwal-lahu ahad. Allahus-samad. Lam yalid walam yoolad. Walam yakun lahoo kufuwan ahad. Qul aAAoothu birabbil-falaq. Min sharri ma khalaq. Wamin sharri ghasiqin itha waqab. Wamin sharrin-naffathati fil-AAuqad. Wamin sharri hasidin itha hasad. Qul aAAoothu birabbin-nas. Malikin-nas. Ilahin-nas. Min sharril-waswasil-khannas. Allathee yuwaswisu fee sudoorin-nas. Minal-jinnati wannas.

Bismi l-lâhi r-rahmâni r-rahîmi.
Qul huwa l-lâhu ahad. Allâhu s-samad, Lam yalid wa lam yûlad, wa lam yakun lahu kufuan ahad.
Bismi l-lâhi r-rahmâni r-rahîmi.
Qul acûdhu bi-rabbi-l-falaq, min sharri mâ khalaq, wa min sharri ghâsiqin idhâ waqab, wa min sharri n-naffâthâti fî-l-cuqad, wa min sharri hâsidin idhâ hasad.
Bismi l-lâhi r-rahmâni r-rahîmi.
Qul acûdhu bi-rabbi n-nâs, maliki n-nâs, ilâhi n-nâs, min sharri-l-waswâsi-l-khannâs, al-ladhî yuwaswisu fî sudûri n-nâs, mina-l-jinnati wa n-nâs.

Allah - there is no deity except Him, the Ever-Living, the Sustainer of [all] existence. Neither drowsiness overtakes Him nor sleep. To Him belongs whatever is in the heavens and whatever is on the earth. Who is it that can intercede with Him except by His permission? He knows what is [presently] before them and what will be after them, and they encompass not a thing of His knowledge except for what He wills. His Kursi extends over the heavens and the earth, and their preservation tires Him not. And He is the Most High, the Most Great.

Allahu la ilaha illa huwal-hayyul-qayyoom, la ta'khuthuhoo sinatun wala nawm, lahoo ma fis-samawati wama fil-ard, man thal-lathee yashfaAAu AAindahoo illa bi-ithnihee, yaAAlamu ma bayna aydeehim wama khalfahum, wala yuheetoona bishay-in min AAilmihee illa bima sha', wasiAAa kursiyyuhus-samawati wal-ard, wala ya-ooduhoo hifthuhuma, wahuwal-AAaliyyul-AAatheem.

Allâhu lâ ilâha illâ huwa-l-hayyu-l-qayyûm. Lâ ta'khudhuhu sinatun wa lâ nawm, lahu mâ fî s-samâwâti wa mâ fî-l-ard. Man dhâ l-ladhî yashfacu cindahu illâ bi-idhnihi. Yaclamu mâ bayna aydîhim wa mâ khalfahum. Wa lâ yuhîtûna bi-shay'in min cilmihi illâ bi-mâ shâ'a. Wasica kursiyyuhu s-samâwâti wa-l-ard. Wa lâ ya'ûduhu hifzuhumâ, wa huwa-l-caliyyu-l-cazîm.

The Messenger has believed in what was revealed to him from his Lord, and [so have] the believers. All of them have believed in Allah and His angels and His books and His messengers, [saying], We make no distinction between any of His messengers. And they say, We hear and we obey. [We seek] Your forgiveness, our Lord, and to You is the [final] destination. Allah does not charge a soul except [with that within] its capacity. It will have [the consequence of] what [good] it has gained, and it will bear [the consequence of] what [evil] it has earned. Our Lord, do not impose blame upon us if we have forgotten or erred. Our Lord, and lay not upon us a burden like that which You laid upon those before us. Our Lord, and burden us not with that which we have no ability to bear. And pardon us; and forgive us; and have mercy upon us. You are our protector, so give us victory over the disbelieving people.

fills.text: Amanar-rasoolu bima unzila ilayhi min rabbihee walmu'minoon, kullun amana billahi wamala-ikatihee wakutubihee warusulihee la nufarriqu bayna ahadin min rusulihee, waqaloo samiAAna wa-ataAAna, ghufranaka rabbana wa-ilaykal-maseer. La yukalliful-lahu nafsan illa wusAAaha, laha ma kasabat waAAalayha mak-tasabat, rabbana la tu-akhithna in naseena aw akhta'na, rabbana wala tahmil AAalayna isran kama hamaltahoo AAalal-latheena min qablina, rabbana wala tuhammilna ma la taqata lana bihee, waAAfu AAanna waghfir lana warhamna, anta mawlana fansurna AAalal-qawmil-kafireen.

Âmana r-rasûlu bimâ unzila ilayhi min rabbihî wa-l-mu'minûna, kullun âmana bi-l-lâhi wa malâ'ikatihî wa kutubihî wa rusulihî lâ nufarriqu bayna ahadin min rusulihî, wa qâlû samicnâ wa atacnâ, ghufrânaka rabbanâ wa ilayka l-masîr. Lâ yukallifu l-lâhu nafsan illâ wuscahâ, lahâ mâ kasabat wa calayhâ mâ ktasabat, rabbanâ lâ tu'âkhidhnâ in nasînâ aw akhta'nâ, rabbanâ wa lâ tahmil calaynâ isran kamâ hamaltahû calâ l-ladhîna min qablinâ, rabbanâ wa lâ tuhammilnâ mâ lâ tâqata lanâ bihî, wa cfu cannâ wa ghfir lanâ wa rhamnâ, anta mawlânâ fa-nsurnâ calâ l-qawmi l-kâfirîn.
aAAoothu billahi minash-shaytani wamin sharri ma ra-ayt.
Je me mets sous la protection d’Allah contre le diable et contre le mal de ce que j’ai vu.
fills.note: translation; wording follows the published "Je me mets sous la protection d’Allah contre Satan"

fills.text: Acûdhu bi-l-lâhi mina sh-shaytâni wa min sharri mâ ra'ayt.

O Allah, Lord of the seven heavens, Lord of the Magnificent Throne, be for me a support against [such and such a person] and his helpers from among your creatures, lest any of them abuse me or do me wrong. Mighty is your patronage and glorious are your praises. There is none worthy of worship but you.

Allahumma rabbas-samawatis-sabAA, warabbal-AAarshil-AAatheem, kun lee jaran min fulani bni fulan, wa-ahzabihi min khala-iqik, an yafruta AAalayya ahadun minhum aw yatgha, AAazza jaruk, wajalla thana-uk, wala ilaha illa ant.

Allah is the Most Great, Mightier than all His creation. He is Mightier than what I fear and dread. I seek refuge in Allah, Who there is none worthy of worship but Him. He is the One Who holds the seven heavens from falling upon the earth except by His command. [I seek refuge in You Allah] from the evil of Your slave [name of the person], and his helpers, his followers and his supporters from among the jinn and mankind. O Allah, be my support against their evil. Glorious Your praises and mighty is Your patronage. Blessed is Your Name, there is no true God but You.

fills.text: Allahu akbar, Allahu aAAazzu min khalqihi jameeAAan, Allahu aAAazzu mimma akhafu wa-ahthar, aAAoothu billahil-lathee la ilaha illa huwa, almumsikis-samawatis-sabAAi an yaqaAAna AAalal-ardi illa bi-ithnih, min sharri AAabdika fulan, wajunoodihi wa-atbaAAihi wa-ashyaAAih, minal-jinni wal-ins, Allahumma kun lee jaran min sharrihim, jalla thana-uka waAAazza jaruk, watabarakas-muk, wala ilaha ghayruk.
He is The First and The Last, Aththahir and Al-Batin and He knows well all things.

fills.text: aAAoothu billahi minash-shaytanir-rajeem.

Allah is the Greatest, Allah is the Greatest, Allah is the Greatest, Allah is the Greatest. I bear witness that none has the right to be worshipped except Allah, I bear witness that none has the right to be worshipped except Allah. I bear witness that Muhammad is the Messenger of Allah, I bear witness that Muhammad is the Messenger of Allah. Come to prayer, come to prayer. Come to success, come to success. Allah is the Greatest, Allah is the Greatest. None has the right to be worshipped except Allah.

Allahu akbar. Allahu akbar. Allahu akbar. Allahu akbar. Ashhadu an la ilaha illal-lah. Ashhadu an la ilaha illal-lah. Ashhadu anna Muhammadan rasoolul-lah. Ashhadu anna Muhammadan rasoolul-lah. Hayya AAalas-salah. Hayya AAalas-salah. Hayya AAalal-falah. Hayya AAalal-falah. Allahu akbar. Allahu akbar. La ilaha illal-lah.

Allah est le plus Grand, Allah est le plus Grand, Allah est le plus Grand, Allah est le plus Grand. J’atteste qu’il n’y a de divinité qu’Allah, j’atteste qu’il n’y a de divinité qu’Allah. J’atteste que Mohammed est le Messager d’Allah, j’atteste que Mohammed est le Messager d’Allah. Venez à la prière, venez à la prière. Venez à la réussite, venez à la réussite. Allah est le plus Grand, Allah est le plus Grand. Il n’y a de divinité qu’Allah.

Allâhu akbar. Allâhu akbar. Allâhu akbar. Allâhu akbar. Ashhadu an lâ ilâha illâ l-lâh. Ashhadu an lâ ilâha illâ l-lâh. Ashhadu anna Muhammadan rasûlu l-lâh. Ashhadu anna Muhammadan rasûlu l-lâh. Hayya calâ s-salâh. Hayya calâ s-salâh. Hayya calâ l-falâh. Hayya calâ l-falâh. Allâhu akbar. Allâhu akbar. Lâ ilâha illâ l-lâh.
May Allah bless you with His gift to you and may you (the new parent) give thanks, may the child reach the maturity of years, and may you be granted its righteousness.
Barakal-lahu laka fil-mawhoobi lak, washakartal-wahib, wabalagha ashuddah, waruziqta birrah.
The reply of the person being congratulated is to say: May Allah bless you, and shower His blessings upon you, and may Allah reward you well and bestow upon you its like and reward you abundantly.
Barakal-lahu laka wabaraka AAalayk, wajazakal-lahu khayran, warazaqakal-lahu mithlah, wa-ajzala thawabak.
Allahummagh-fir lah, Allahumma thabbit-hu.

Allahumma innee aAAoothu bika min AAathabil-qabr, wamin AAathabi jahannam, wamin fitnatil-mahya walmamat, wamin sharri fitnatil-maseehid-dajjal, Allahumma innee aAAoothu bika minal-ma'thami walmaghram.

Ô Seigneur ! Je me mets sous Ta protection contre le châtiment de la tombe, contre le châtiment de l’Enfer, contre l’épreuve de la vie et de la mort et contre le mal de l’épreuve de l’Antéchrist. Ô Seigneur ! Je me mets sous Ta protection contre le péché et contre la dette.
